ops.body: A3.4 landed: bba8159c on c8b8a678 (945 passed +11; my independent suite green; ty/ruff clean on touched code). G1: new AccountingIntegrityError(ResearchError); CostError became its SUBCLASS so any partial/missing envelope routes through classify() to a new 'accounting' verdict → run_unit raises → loud abort; recovered_cost distinguishes no-billing-evidence (total_cost_usd absent → 0.0, normal wall-cancel) from evidence-present-but-unparseable (abort); stop() raises AccountingIntegrityError on non-ProcessLookupError OSError. G2: launch() gained an on_spawn hook invoked in a shielded CancelScope immediately after open_process (pidfile write moved AFTER); driver retains via _recovery.retain and stops the retained run if launch is cancelled — orphan window closed by ordering. G3: run() validates outcome.cost finite>=0 BEFORE the JournalRow append; violation = AccountingIntegrityError (harness contract), never candidate/infra. G4: parse_event requires kind ∈ {retry, wall_cancel}; missing/invalid = malformed-skip; the get(default) compat removed. Sidecar matrix extended (-Infinity, bool). INTENTIONAL WIDENING (flagged by implementer, accepted, and sent to the round-3 refuter as an explicit target): any missing/invalid envelope now aborts — incl. a completed proposal with no envelope — per 'billing state unknown → abort'; refuter attacks spurious-abort paths, verdict routing at every catch site, and post-abort resume arithmetic. Round-3 re-refute running on bba8159c — clean pass ships the release.
